'''Durable plastifoam''' was a unique type of [[plastifoam]], a kind of packing material, that was developed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]].<ref name="Chaos" />

==Behind the scenes==
Durable plastifoam was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], by the non-player character [[Eckard Lokin]] during the [[Imperial Agent]] mission "Chaos on a Broken World" on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="Chaos" />
